replacement_text.visible_action: The flag box closes on a small plume in the camera's display and the alert card travels out to the crew truck, landing on the dash phone as a bubble. A ten minute window fills on the dash clock up to an estimated within ten minutes tag. With the plume still burning, a dashed line runs from the landed alert toward a first responder badge and stops short, open, under a Can share tag.
replacement_text.human_consequence: AEP Texas crews get a text or an email within an estimated ten minutes when a camera detects heat or smoke. The cameras don't prevent fires. AEP says the awareness can be shared with first responders, the source describes no alert step to responders, and AEP publishes no response record.
